secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (Supabase dashboard > Project Settings > API > Project URL). Required for auth, DB queries, and most data features.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon public key (Supabase dashboard > Project Settings > API > anon public). Paired with NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role key (Supabase dashboard > Project Settings > API > service_role). Used by admin/server-side queries.

secrets.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe secret key (Stripe dashboard > Developers > API keys > Secret key). Required for the shop checkout flow.

secrets.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Stripe webhook signing secret (Stripe dashboard > Developers > Webhooks > your endpoint > Signing secret). Required to verify webhook events.

secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
secrets.description: Resend API key (Resend dashboard > API keys). Required for sending emails.

secrets.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenRouter API key (OpenRouter dashboard > Keys). Required for AI/openrouter features.

secrets.name: R2_ACCOUNT_ID
secrets.description: Cloudflare R2 account ID (Cloudflare dashboard > R2 > Overview). Required for image uploads.

secrets.name: R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID
secrets.description: Cloudflare R2 access key ID (Cloudflare dashboard > R2 > Manage R2 API tokens). Required for image uploads.

secrets.name: R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
secrets.description: Cloudflare R2 secret access key (Cloudflare dashboard > R2 > Manage R2 API tokens). Required for image uploads.

secrets.name: R2_BUCKET_NAME
secrets.description: Cloudflare R2 bucket name. Required for image uploads.

secrets.name: R2_PUBLIC_URL
secrets.description: Cloudflare R2 bucket public URL, e.g. https://pub-xxxx.r2.dev (R2 > bucket > Settings > Public access). Required for image uploads.
